# EnterpriseGlue v0.17.2 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.17.1`.

## Highlights

- **plugin-package-publication:** Publishes plugin runtime 0.2.1 for plugin SDK 0.3.1, patches each dependent public package, and detects workspace dependency drift before immutable publication.

## User and administrator impact

- Plugin package consumers can install a runtime package whose declared plugin SDK dependency matches the current public SDK release.

## Upgrade and compatibility

- Use @enterpriseglue/plugin-runtime 0.2.1 with @enterpriseglue/plugin-sdk 0.3.1, installer 0.2.4, Plugin Manager 0.1.4, backend host 0.7.1, frontend host 0.9.1, and the matching 0.2.4 runtime/RBAC and 0.1.4 manager Helm charts.

## API and integration compatibility

- The runtime, host, installer, and manager APIs are unchanged; only their immutable package versions and resolved workspace dependency metadata change.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Documentation

- Release notes record the corrected package dependency contracts, coupled chart versions, and publication guard.

## Published packages

| Package | Previous | New | Impact |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `@enterpriseglue/backend-host` | `0.7.0` | `0.7.1` | patch |
| `@enterpriseglue/frontend-host` | `0.9.0` | `0.9.1` | patch |
| `@enterpriseglue/plugin-installer` | `0.2.3` | `0.2.4` | patch |

| `@enterpriseglue/plugin-runtime` | `0.2.0` | `0.2.1` | patch |

## Rollback

- Continue using the previous package set only as one immutable unit; no database or configuration rollback is required.

## Validation evidence

- Workspace dependency version-drift regression tests
- Published-package version discipline
- Protected plugin package build, pack, publication, and registry verification
